declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poisson_decay_step
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem poisson_decay_step {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    t / (1 + t * (n + 1)) ^ 2 ≤
      1 / (1 + t * n) - 1 / (1 + t * (n + 1))

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poisson_decay_sum_range_le
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem poisson_decay_sum_range_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, t / (1 + t * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) ≤ 1

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poisson_decay_summable_nat
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem poisson_decay_summable_nat {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ t / (1 + t * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2)

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poisson_decay_tsum_nat_le
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem poisson_decay_tsum_nat_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, t / (1 + t * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) ≤ 1

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroDecay
declarations.complete_source_definition:
def poissonNonzeroDecay (t : ℝ) (h : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  if h = 0 then 0 else t / (1 + |t * h|) ^ 2

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroDecay_summable_tsum_le
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem poissonNonzeroDecay_summable_tsum_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Summable (poissonNonzeroDecay t) ∧ (∑' h : ℤ, poissonNonzeroDecay t h) ≤ 2

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency_uniform
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem poissonNonzeroFrequency_uniform :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x : ℝ,
      ‖∑' h : ℤ, poissonNonzeroFrequency t x h‖ ≤ C

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_progression_uniform_error
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_progression_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → ∀ b : ℤ,
      |(∑ m ∈ S, if Int.ModEq q (m : ℤ) b then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
          (M / q) * cutoffMass| ≤ C

declarations.name: ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_multiples_uniform_error
declarations.complete_source_header:
theorem scaledDyadicCutoff_finset_multiples_uniform_error :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∀ S : Finset ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, scaledDyadicCutoff M m ≠ 0 → m ∈ S) →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      |(∑ m ∈ S, if q ∣ m then scaledDyadicCutoff M m else 0) -
          (M / q) * cutoffMass| ≤ C
